name: Drake Hotline Bling
description: Drake looking away in disgust, then smiling approvingly at the second option.
use_case: Comparing something bad vs something good.

name: Distracted Boyfriend
description: A man looking at another woman while his girlfriend looks angry.
use_case: Choosing a new tempting option over your current commitment.

name: Two Buttons
description: A man sweating while trying to choose between two conflicting buttons.
use_case: Hard decisions where both options lead to anxiety.

name: Change My Mind
description: A man sitting at a desk with a sign challenging others to debate his opinion.

name: Expanding Brain
description: A series of brains getting progressively more glowing and complex.
use_case: Comparing simple ideas to absurdly 'genius' ideas.

name: Woman Yelling at Cat
description: A woman screaming and pointing while a confused cat sits at a dinner table.
use_case: Accusing someone who is completely innocent or indifferent.

name: Gru's Plan
description: Gru presenting steps of his evil plan on a board, then realizing the final step backfires.
use_case: A plan that goes disastrously wrong at the end.

name: Panik Kalm Panik
description: Meme man reacting with panic, then relief, then sudden extreme panic.
use_case: A rollercoaster of bad news, false hope, and worse news.

name: Disaster Girl
description: A little girl smiling deviously at the camera while a house burns in the background.
use_case: Taking pleasure in chaos or causing unintentional destruction.

name: This Is Fine Dog
description: A dog wearing a hat sipping coffee in a room completely engulfed in flames.
use_case: Denying a clearly disastrous situation while staying calm.
